SCOPE: Only src/pages/Chat.jsx. Do NOT touch any other file.

ALREADY_KNOWN:

- It renders messages in a loop with isMine detection
- It has a recruiter-only calendar button to toggle scheduling

REQUIREMENTS — COMPLETE APPOINTMENT FLOW:

**A. Firestore message structure for appointments:**
When recruiter clicks "Proposer un entretien", instead of sending one date, send a message with:
```js
{
  chatId, senderId, type: 'appointment_proposal',
  slots: ['2026-07-10T09:00', '2026-07-10T14:00', '2026-07-11T10:00'], // 3 créneaux
  status: 'pending',
  acceptedSlot: null,
  timestamp: serverTimestamp()
}
```

**B. Recruiter UI changes:**
Replace the current single datetime-local input with a form that lets the recruiter pick 3 time slots (3 datetime-local inputs). Label them "Créneau 1", "Créneau 2", "Créneau 3". Button: "Proposer ces 3 créneaux". Validate: at least 1 slot must be filled.

**D. Acceptance flow:**

2. Show a toast: "Créneau accepté !"
3. The message re-renders in accepted state

**E. Accepted state rendering:**
When status === 'accepted':
- Show a green banner/bandeau: "✅ Entretien confirmé"
- Display the accepted date prominently
- Show "En attente de confirmation par le recruteur" or similar
- Buttons are NO longer clickable

**F. Recruiter view of accepted:**
When the recruiter sees an accepted appointment_proposal:
- Show the same green banner
- Show which slot was accepted

**G. Styling:**
- Appointment card: bg-gradient-to-r from-teal-50 to-cyan-50 border border-teal-200 rounded-2xl p-4
- Slot buttons (pending): bg-sky-50 hover:bg-cyan-100 border border-sky-200 rounded-xl px-4 py-2 text-sm font-bold text-sky-700 transition-all
- Accepted banner: bg-teal-500 text-white rounded-xl px-4 py-3 font-bold
